drums.tags: Amapiano. Log drum basslines with a percussive, woody timbre play syncopated patterns. Shakers and high-pitched woodblocks provide a constant 16th-note rhythmic layer. A clean, Rhodes-style electric piano plays jazzy, sustained chords. A bright, plucked synth lead enters with a repetitive melodic motif. The track features a prominent four-on-the-floor kick drum with a soft, rounded attack. Tempo is 113 BPM in the key of G minor. The arrangement is built on a minimalist loop with subtle filter sweeps on the synth pads and occasional rimshot accents.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[shakers and woodblock percussion enter]
[soft kick drum enters]
[sustained Rhodes piano chords]

[Section A]
[log drum bass enters with syncopated rhythmic pattern]
[bright plucked synth melody enters]

[Section B]
[filter sweep on synth pads]
[rimshot accents and additional percussion layers]
[log drum pattern intensifies]

[Outro]
[synth melody fades out]
[log drum and kick drum continue]
[percussion tapers off to silence]
